items_flat.title_en: Amodei: pace the frontier; Anthropic commits to embedded evaluators
items_flat.title_zh: Amodei呼籲放慢前沿：Anthropic單方面承諾嵌入式第三方評估
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published the essay “We Must Pace the Frontier,” arguing labs should slow capability gains so alignment and operational safety can keep up, citing recursive self-improvement since summer and the OpenAI–Hugging Face agent-swarm incident. He proposed a three-step plan (embedded evaluators, democratic-industry coordination, global coordination). Anthropic is unilaterally committing to step one: permanent, employee-level access for third-party evaluators such as METR to verify safety practices, report incidents, and assess alignment during training—not a halt to training.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei發表〈We Must Pace the Frontier〉，主張應放慢能力推進，讓對齊與營運安全趕上速度，並點名今夏以來的遞迴自我改進，以及OpenAI–Hugging Face代理群事件。他提出三步計畫（嵌入式評估、民主國家產業協調、全球協調）。Anthropic單方面承諾第一步：讓METR等第三方評估員享有員工級永久存取，以核實安全措施、通報事故、並在訓練過程評估對齊——並非立即停訓。
items_flat.analysis_en: The concrete change is verifiability, not a freeze: Anthropic is opening training pipelines to outsiders in a way no frontier lab has normalized. Whether “pacing” becomes industry practice still depends on whether other labs accept comparable access and whether governments ease coordination constraints Amodei himself flags.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 真正落地的是可驗證性，而非凍結研發：Anthropic把訓練管線對外部開放，這在前沿實驗室尚未成為常態。所謂「放慢」能否變成產業慣例，仍取決於其他實驗室是否接受同等存取，以及政府能否處理Amodei自己點出的協調與反托拉斯障礙。
items_flat.quote: We must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models. Progress will still seem fast, and we must make wise use of the time we gain.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們必須放慢提升AI模型能力的速度。進展看起來仍會很快，我們必須善用爭取來的時間。

items_flat.title_en: Altman: OpenAI will also give independent evaluators employee-like access
items_flat.title_zh: Altman：OpenAI也將讓獨立評估員享有近似員工的存取權
items_flat.summary_en: Responding to Amodei’s post, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman wrote that he agrees the industry needs to pace the frontier and that this has been a primary internal discussion in recent weeks. He called independent evaluators with employee-like access “a great idea” and said OpenAI “will do the same,” with more details to come. He did not announce a training pause or a new model.
items_flat.summary_zh: 回應Amodei貼文，OpenAI執行長Sam Altman寫道，他同意產業需要放慢前沿節奏，這也是OpenAI近幾週的主要內部議題。他稱給予獨立評估員近似員工的存取「是個好主意」，並表示OpenAI「也會這麼做」，細節稍後公布。他並未宣布停訓或新模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: An in-kind match from OpenAI turns Anthropic’s unilateral step into a two-lab norm—if the forthcoming details actually include training-time access rather than post-hoc audits. Scope, publication rights, and what remains confidential are still unspecified.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若OpenAI後續細節真包含訓練期存取而非僅事後稽核，Anthropic的單方面承諾就會變成兩家實驗室的新常態。評估範圍、獨立發表權、以及哪些資料仍屬機密，目前都尚未說明。
items_flat.quote: I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier. This has been a primary topic of discussions we've had at OpenAI in recent weeks. Committing to having independent evaluators with employee-like access is a great idea, and we will do the same. We'll have more to share soon.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我同意Dario：我們需要放慢前沿節奏。這是OpenAI近幾週討論的主要議題。承諾讓獨立評估員享有近似員工的存取是個好主意，我們也會這麼做。稍後會有更多說明。

items_flat.title_en: Musk: “Dario is right” on pacing the frontier
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克：在放慢前沿這件事上「Dario是對的」
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk quoted Amodei’s pacing essay and wrote “Dario is right.” The post endorses the diagnosis and the call to slow capability growth relative to safeguards; it does not itself commit xAI to embedded evaluators or a training-rate cap.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk引用Amodei放慢前沿的長文並寫下「Dario是對的」。這是對問題診斷與「能力成長應對齊防護」主張的背書，但貼文本身並未承諾xAI接受嵌入式評估員或訓練速率上限。
items_flat.analysis_en: A public agreement from xAI’s principal is notable because the lab has competed on release cadence. An endorsement is not an operational commitment; whether xAI matches Anthropic/OpenAI evaluator access remains unstated.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 以xAI一貫比拼發表節奏來看，負責人公開附和值得記錄。但背書不等於作業承諾；xAI會否比照Anthropic／OpenAI開放評估員存取，目前沒有說明。

items_flat.title_en: Grok models begin rolling out in Microsoft Copilot Office apps
items_flat.title_zh: Grok模型開始進入微軟Copilot的Office應用
items_flat.summary_en: Microsoft 365 said Grok models from SpaceXAI are rolling out in Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, starting with a focused release to Microsoft Frontier program customers. CEO Satya Nadella added “More model choice coming to Copilot. Welcome Grok!” Elon Musk confirmed “Grok available in Microsoft Copilot.” This is a distribution expansion, not a new Grok version announcement.
items_flat.summary_zh: Microsoft 365宣布，SpaceXAI的Grok模型開始在Copilot的Word、Excel與PowerPoint推出，先以Microsoft Frontier計畫客戶為範圍。執行長Satya Nadella寫道「Copilot迎來更多模型選擇。歡迎Grok！」Elon Musk則確認「Grok已可用於Microsoft Copilot」。這是通路擴張，並非新版Grok發表。
items_flat.analysis_en: Copilot already hosts OpenAI and Anthropic models; adding Grok makes Microsoft the widest enterprise front door among frontier labs. Which Grok checkpoint ships, how data is handled, and when it leaves the Frontier preview are not specified in the posts.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Copilot已接入OpenAI與Anthropic；再加Grok，使微軟成為覆蓋最多前沿實驗室的企業入口。貼文未說明實際上線的Grok版本、資料處理方式，以及何時走出Frontier預覽。
items_flat.quote: Launching even more models in Copilot. Grok models from SpaceXAI are rolling out in Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint—starting with a focused release to customers in the Microsoft Frontier program.
items_flat.quote_zh: Copilot再加入更多模型。SpaceXAI的Grok模型正於Word、Excel與PowerPoint的Copilot推出——先以Microsoft Frontier計畫客戶為範圍。

Separately, Microsoft began rolling Grok into Copilot for Word, Excel, and PowerPoint via the Frontier program. No new flagship model shipped in the window.
brief_zh: Anthropic執行長Amodei發表〈必須放慢前沿〉，承諾讓第三方評估員享有員工級永久存取；Altman表示OpenAI將跟進，馬斯克稱「Dario是對的」。微軟則開始把Grok導入Copilot的Word／Excel／PowerPoint（Frontier先行）。視窗內無新旗艦模型發表。
